description: This file contains Makefile macros and definitions related to building root filesystem images, handling libraries, and package management tasks in an embedded Linux build environment.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Macro to find, build, strip, and copy libraries and executables for embedded system.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: Macro to configure opkg package manager with specific options.
